SMTO-WEB-0044 — SMTO already tried this exact search or page

GUID: 7de33642-ab15-564d-b81e-f0ca18c608a3
Slug: research-duplicate-acquisition
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • SMTO tried to repeat a web search or page read it had already done in this task. It didn't repeat it; the earlier result, even if it failed, is kept and should be used instead.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let SMTO continue; it should use the earlier result or move on to another source. Repeating the exact same request wouldn't give new information and would use up the task's limits.
  2. If you think the page has changed since, send a new message asking SMTO to check it again. A new request starts fresh research, so SMTO can read the current version.
  3. If SMTO keeps repeating this, send a message pointing it to a different website or link. A new source gives SMTO something useful to read instead of the one it already tried.

What success looks like

  • SMTO's activity moves on to a different source or to its answer.

If it still fails

  • If SMTO seems stuck on the same request, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • web_research acquisitions.reserve() found an equivalent earlier acquisition (same tool, canonical arguments and browser epoch), and neither the one allowed same-transport retry nor retained-document reuse applies, so the request was not dispatched.

What this means

  • The acquisition ledger contains an equivalent prior request and neither the bounded explicit-retry exception nor retained-document reuse applies. The rejected acquisition is not dispatched. Earlier acquisitions and their evidence remain; another access needs its ordinary permission and allowance.

Why this can happen

  • The acquisition ledger contains an equivalent prior request and neither the bounded explicit-retry exception nor retained-document reuse applies.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the canonical request signature, prior receipt and retry eligibility.

How to fix it

  • Read the prior acquisition's outcome (via its acquisition_id / receipt) instead of re-requesting it. A repeat is allowed only after a receipt marked same_transport_retry for an idempotent request; otherwise choose a different source.
  • Use retained evidence or another model-selected acquisition. Retry only after an explicit retryable receipt.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use retained evidence or another model-selected acquisition. Retry only after an explicit retryable receipt.

How to verify the fix

  • The next action reuses retained evidence or is a permitted distinct acquisition.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a settled acquisition merely to obtain a new identifier; inspect its existing outcome.

Technical notes

  • The rejected acquisition is not dispatched. Earlier acquisitions and their evidence remain; another access needs its ordinary permission and allowance.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
